_comment: Verdicts checked by hand in a browser, for sites verify.py can't read (anti-bot or JS-only pages). Keyed by application URL; apply_manual.py writes them over data/verified.json after every verify run. Entry format: "<url>": {"verdict": "ok" | "no_sponsorship" | "citizen_only" | "dead", "real_title": "...", "flag": "", "flag_note": "what you saw"}
